title: Integrated invocation-response AST projection interface first
scope: upstream interface/type contract and public type exports only; runtime executor and scanner implementations untouched

checks.name: AST projection consumes existing response ADTs through type-only imports
semantic projection context requires both canonical judgments
response projection is indexed by the exact invocation subtype
projection result returns the same correlated invocation and response ADTs
AST projection authority declares generic input-to-output preservation
authority contract forbids response reclassification and reconstruction
controller artifact already owns both judgments as one ADT
response outcome remains closed and rejected source binding is preserved
new projection context and response projection type are publicly exported
no relation/foundation replacement layer is introduced
no new scanner or parallel invocation authority is introduced
existing AST projection runtime remains unchanged for interface-first sequencing

knownGap: The current runtime AST projection authority still emits invocation-only projection and must be migrated later to forward responseJudgment; this phase deliberately does not modify runtime before the contract is settled.
